description: A human participant — the Person branch of Agent.

name.description: Display name. ABSENT until resolved: a Person is identified by `@id` and nothing else, and what they are called is recorded once per change on the knowledge base's own log and filled in when a record is read (PERSON-PROFILE). An artifact therefore never freezes a name, which is what lets a correction reach every artifact its subject ever wrote. Absent also means genuinely unknown — a DID this knowledge base has no profile for.
